subject: zoology_2
question_text: Name the cranial meninges covering the brain of man.

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.51, VSAQ 82. The printed exam years are the book's claim, reproduced here as appearances. Zoology-II holds only ONE source book in the corpus, so the two-book union check is structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is our reading of the question and is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The three meninges
steps.why: Three layers of different thickness both cushion the brain and carry its blood supply.
common_mistakes: Naming two only. There are three.
Getting the order wrong. Dura is outer, pia is inner.
steps.margin_note: Name all three, then describe each in a few words.
lines: The brain of man is covered and protected

steps.label: What each is like
steps.why: The outer layer is tough for protection and the inner one thin so it can follow every fold of the brain.
common_mistakes: Describing the piamater as thick. It is thin and closely attached.
steps.memory_tip: Dura is tough, arachnoid is web-like, pia is thin and clinging.
steps.margin_note: A few words for each is enough.
lines: Duramater is an outer thick double layered
Arachnoid membrane is a thin net like

lines.text: Piamater is thin and clings to the brain

insider_note: Naming the three earns one mark; a word about each earns the second. Two extra words per line is all it takes.
